meta.title: {{NAME}}
meta.note: Template example: a box with a PLA frame between two acrylic plates, holding an object inside. Rewrite each item to fit your own shape. The process list of a fab item names the methods that use the value (laser = laser cutting, fdm = 3D printing)

hole_inset.label: Screw hole center to outer edge (acrylic: at least 1.5× the hole diameter)

t_top.label: Top plate thickness
t_top.basis: Nominal size. 3mm acrylic can be off by ±0.7mm (MISUMI), so measure each sheet with calipers and replace this value

kerf.label: Laser kerf (full cut width k; the offset is k/2)
kerf.basis: Middle of the published values for 3mm acrylic on a CO2 laser: 0.125 (measured by Ponoko) to 0.18 (CutLaserCut guideline). Measure it with a coupon

clr_fit.label: General clearance for 3D prints (per side)
clr_fit.basis: General value for the Ultimaker S7 from a university lab's table. No source for an Ender-3 value. Decide with a 3-step coupon (-0.1 / 0 / +0.1)

clr_slide.label: Clearance for removable and sliding fits in 3D prints (per side)

hole_comp.label: Vertical hole enlargement (in CAD; 0 if the slicer compensates)
hole_comp.basis: Pollen AM rule of thumb (draw a 4mm hole as 4.2mm). Compensate in either CAD or the slicer, not both

insert_hole.label: Pilot hole diameter for M3 heat-set inserts
insert_hole.basis: CNC Kitchen and ruthex 4.0; UW–Madison about 4.3. Decide with coupons from 4.0 to 4.4

insert_depth.label: Pilot hole depth for M3 short inserts (length 3.0 + 1)
insert_depth.basis: CNC Kitchen: blind hole depth is insert length + 1mm

boss_d.label: Insert boss outer diameter (hole diameter + 2 × minimum wall 1.6)

overhang_deg.label: Overhang angle printable without support (measured from horizontal; downward faces shallower than this need support)
overhang_deg.basis: Common FDM guide (the 45° rule). It changes with printer, material, cooling and layer height, so check it with an overhang test print

screw_clear.label: M3 bolt clearance hole (JIS B 1001 class 2)

usb_cut_w.label: USB-C cutout width (set by the thickness of the cable plug)
usb_cut_w.basis: Overmold width 12.35 (footprint per the USB-C spec) + margin. Test with the thickest cable you have
